mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM order_items WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM order_items WHERE id = #{id} AND order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_items, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) as unique_products, COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) as total_amount, COALESCE(AVG(product_price), 0) as average_price, COALESCE(AVG(quantity), 0) as average_quantity, COALESCE(AVG(subtotal), 0) as average_subtotal FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, COUNT(oi.id) as item_count, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) as total_amount, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal) * 100.0 / (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId}), 2) as percentage FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN product_price < 50 THEN '0-50' WHEN product_price BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN '50-100' WHEN product_price BETWEEN 100 AND 200 THEN '100-200' WHEN product_price BETWEEN 200 AND 500 THEN '200-500' WHEN product_price BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN '500-1000' ELSE '1000+' END as price_range, COUNT(*) as item_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} GROUP BY price_range ORDER BY CASE price_range WHEN '0-50' THEN 1 WHEN '50-100' THEN 2 WHEN '100-200' THEN 3 WHEN '200-500' THEN 4 WHEN '500-1000' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

SELECT CASE WHEN quantity = 1 THEN '1' WHEN quantity = 2 THEN '2' WHEN quantity = 3 THEN '3' WHEN quantity BETWEEN 4 AND 5 THEN '4-5' ELSE '6+' END as quantity_range, COUNT(*) as item_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} GROUP BY quantity_range ORDER BY CASE quantity_range WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 2 WHEN '3' THEN 3 WHEN '4-5' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT product_sku as sku, product_name as product_name, COUNT(*) as order_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} GROUP BY product_sku, product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT product_image as product_image, COUNT(*) as order_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND product_image IS NOT NULL AND product_image != '' GROUP BY product_image ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.brand as brand_name, COUNT(oi.id) as item_count, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} AND p.brand IS NOT NULL AND p.brand != '' GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name, p.image as product_image, p.price as product_price, COUNT(oi.id) as order_count, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) as total_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC) as quantity_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) DESC) as amount_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.price DESC) as price_rank, (RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC) + RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) DESC) + RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.price DESC)) as comprehensive_rank FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.image, p.price ORDER BY comprehensive_rank LIMIT #{limit}
